text_block_list.text: The very first Dream Fest—

Amidst a dazzling array of unique 
personalities, <chrname> has claimed a brilliant 
victory!

Amidst a dazzling array of unique 
personalities, <chrname> also ran through to the 
finish.

It seems that run became quite a hot topic 
among the fans—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: <chrname>, isn't that amazing!?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"The way you ran really captivated me. 
Your live performance was great too♪"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Nice, you found an oshi! I got myself a 
new oshi too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I knew her name and all, but seeing her 
run live in person was just... way too 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, shh!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...You can't help but wonder about their 
reactions after all, can you? I feel the 
same way."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, honestly, I'm a bit of a worrier. I 
kept wondering if everyone had fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Right, this was my first time watching 
one, but... races are insanely intense! 
And above all, all the Umamusume are super 
cute!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Totally! If you look closely, even their 
racewear has so much personality in the 
details... My fave's super flashy, and her 
appeal is off the charts!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan C
text_block_list.text:
While watching the Winning Live, one of 
the girls gave insane fan service...! 
Kyaa~, my heart's still pounding!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, since we're here, why don't we 
exchange contact info? As fellow race 
newbies, let's watch together!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. That's the first step, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Great work out there, <nickname>-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Her unique individuality was truly 
shining. —She really is a wonderful 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
“—And that wraps up the highly anticipated 
Dream Fest. Will there be a next time? 
Expectations are high! Moving on to our 
next story—”

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Umamusume races, huh~? Come to 
think of it, maybe I've never actually 
watched one.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text:
Papa, you used to love that, right? Wanna 
go sometime?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hmmm... Daddy will pass. The girl 
Daddy was rooting for probably won't be 
running anymore...—

Parting ways with Haiseiko, I walk alone 
and think. I feel like I've achieved a 
certain degree of success in communicating 
the charm of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
—The girl I'm rooting for seemed to get 
quite a few fans from that festival race! 
When I searched online, a ton of posts 
came up!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
It's a great race, ain't it? Things are 
only gonna get more exciting from here on 
out, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder. Well, festivals are all well 
and good, but... Fans you gain from that 
sort of thing will vanish in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I really wanna see a heated, 
all-out race. That's what racing's all 
about, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monitor Sound
text_block_list.text:
"My thoughts on Dream Fest? It was super 
fun! I realized there are so many 
different girls out there!"

text_block_list.name: Monitor Sound
text_block_list.text:
"Why not do it again? I'd love to go! 
Though I kind of want to see a serious 
race too!"

text_block_list.name: Monitor Sound
text_block_list.text:
"‘After all, the Twinkle Series is all 
about those fierce, sparks-flying races! 
Don't you think?’"

text_block_list.name: Monitor Sound
text_block_list.text:
"Please take on all kinds of challenges! 
I'll be cheering you on~!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Just as I thought. Ahead of us lies...—"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: —What lies ahead... you ask?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The next step for "Dream Fest"? Or... are 
you thinking even further ahead?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No, rather than that... It's a deeply 
personal matter, you see.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
My. Secretive... are you? You have changed 
a little since your active days, My Lord.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Yes, somehow... She "wears" it.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I am honored. To think that you knew of 
me during my active racing days.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Of course. After all, you too, Sir... have 
walked upon "my path."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Every year, every single year... I shall 
watch over you. —Next year too, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be that the next development 
for the 'Dream Fest' is already taking 
shape within you?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I have made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I shall fulfill my new duty splendidly. 
—Just as I did back then.
